Class BricksTest

java.lang.Object
com.tetris.bricks.BricksTest
class BricksTest extends Object
Test suite for verifying the structural integrity and rotation data of all Tetris brick types.

This class contains unit tests for each concrete implementation of the Brick interface (I, J, L, O, S, T, Z).

Author:
Jacob Villegas
